name: Protopasta HTPLA @base
filament_notes:
Covers Premium HTPLA v3, High Temp PLA v2 and all color lines (opaque, translucent, metallic, glitter, fluorescent, Quantum Dot, glow).
220C suits ~6 mm3/s; raise toward 240C at 12 mm3/s (240C also improves layer fusion). Quantum Dot TDS: 220-240C nozzle, 55-65C bed.
Anneal for heat resistance up to ~140-155C (vs ~55-60C as printed): oven at 85-115C for 5-60 min, ideally buried in silica sand or submerged in gel; treat with supports on.
Prusa MK2/MK3 stock heatbreak: 235-240C helps avoid heat-creep jams.
